dct_creator_sm: Fisher, Jason (University of Victoria, School of Environmental Studies, ACME Lab, School of Environmental Studies, University of Victoria, School of Environmental Studies, ACME Lab). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9020-6509
dct_description_sm: Data and data-processing scripts in R format https://www.r-project.org for the manuscript "Integration of aerial surveys and resource selection analysis indicates human land-use supports boreal deer expansion". This research examines white-tailed deer distribution in Alberta's boreal forest in relation to natural landscape features, and anthropogenic features left by extensive resource development.
dct_title_s: Integration of aerial surveys and resource selection analysis indicates human land-use supports boreal deer expansion
